chunks.title: Mobile Money and local payments
chunks.text: Yes. We design for Uganda first — Mobile Money, mobile-first use, and connections your customers actually have — then scale outward when you need it.

chunks.title: How long does a typical project take?
chunks.text: Sleek Pages can go live in about a day once you pick a layout. Multi-page websites usually take a few weeks. Mobile apps and business systems are scoped after a short conversation so the timeline matches the work.

chunks.title: How much will it cost?
chunks.text: Website packages start from published prices on our pricing page. Apps and custom systems are quoted after we understand the workflow. You get a written scope before we start — no surprise invoices.

chunks.title: Will you still be here after launch?
chunks.text: Yes. Launch is the start of the relationship. We stay involved for fixes, improvements, and guidance as the product grows with your business.

chunks.title: How do we get started?
chunks.text: Tell us what you need on the contact page. A real person replies within one working day with a clear next step — usually a short call and a written plan.

chunks.title: Can I see real work before I decide?
chunks.text: Yes. Browse live layouts in our projects gallery, open the previews, and click through them. What you see is published work, not mockups.

chunks.title: What is a Sleek Page?
chunks.text: A premium one-page or compact layout we personalise for your brand and publish quickly. It is a finished foundation — not a DIY builder kit.

chunks.title: How fast can I go live?
chunks.text: Most Sleek Pages launch within about a day once you have chosen a layout and shared your logo, colours and copy. If content is missing, we help you fill the gaps first.

chunks.title: Do you build online shops?
chunks.text: Yes — product pages, cart and checkout suited to your catalogue size. For Mobile Money and local payments, we design around how your customers actually pay.

chunks.title: Can you integrate Mobile Money?
chunks.text: Yes. Mobile Money is a first-class requirement for most of the apps we build — not a nice-to-have.

chunks.title: What currency are these prices in?
chunks.text: All listed prices are in Ugandan Shillings (UGX). We do not convert to other currencies on this page — the number you see is what we quote in UGX.

chunks.title: How do website layout orders work?
chunks.text: Ready website layouts from the portfolio use deposit checkout. Custom apps and systems start with a conversation and a scoped quote — no surprise invoices.

chunks.title: Is tax included?
chunks.text: Listed package prices exclude VAT unless we state otherwise in your written quote. Tax treatment is confirmed before you pay a deposit.

chunks.title: What counts as a business system?
chunks.text: Software your team uses to run the operation — CRM, POS, inventory, HR, invoicing, bookings, school or SACCO platforms. If it replaces a messy spreadsheet, it belongs here.
